title: 第20章 王子与灰姑娘单方面宣布版第21章 他对塞娜有感情吗
slug: 百世轮回词条无限累加
lines: 午饭是塞娜送来的。
原本苏璃对这种穷乡僻壤的伙食没抱任何希望。
但他看着碗里那炖得软烂的豆子，还有那一块不知道是什么动物身上的肉，闻着那股子混合着香草和油脂的香气，愣是没挑出半点毛病。
“这是……你做的？”苏璃拿着那个木勺，抬头看了一眼正扒着门框往里瞅的塞娜。
塞娜脸上还是那副怯生生的样儿，两只手在围裙上搓来搓去，像是要把那块布搓出火星子。
“嗯。”塞娜点了点头，声音小得跟蚊子哼哼似的，“要是……要是不合胃口，我再去给你弄点咸菜。”
苏璃没说话，低头尝了一口。
豆子入口即化，肉虽然有点柴，但炖得很入味，最关键的是那汤里加了一种不知名的野草，把那股子豆腥味压得死死的，反而提炼出一股子鲜甜。
这手艺，绝了。
谁能想到，这么个长着一张麻子脸、看着粗手大脚的姑娘，做起饭来竟然这么细致。
苏璃三两下就把那一大碗豆子炖肉扒拉进了肚子，连汤底都用黑面包擦得干干净净。
“好吃。”苏璃放下碗，满足地打了个饱嗝，“真好吃。”
姑娘那脸瞬间亮堂了起来，嘴角怎么压都压不住，想笑又不好意思笑，最后憋得满脸通红，抓起空碗转身就跑。
“那个……晚上还有！”
看着那个跑得比兔子还快的背影，苏璃靠在柴火堆上，摸着肚皮，惬意地眯起了眼。
这日子，好像也没那么难熬。
有吃有喝，不用动脑子，不用担心被人算计，只要出卖一点劳动力，就能换来这种神仙都不换的安稳。
要是能一直这么苟下去，苟到八十岁，这f级的评价也能混成个c级吧？
“小子！吃饱了就给老子起来！”
老巴克的大嗓门在院子里炸开，把苏璃那点刚刚冒头的懒筋给吓了回去。
“来了来了。”苏璃拍了拍屁股上的灰，认命地站起身。
打铁这活儿，看着是力气活，其实也是个技术活。
尤其是当你身边站着个更年期的暴躁师傅时。
“腰挺直！你是虾米吗？”
“手腕用力！别用蛮力！那是巧劲儿！你当你在锄地呢？”
“风箱拉大点！没吃饭吗？火都让你给拉灭了！”
整个下午，铁匠铺里除了叮叮当当的打铁声，就是老巴克的咆哮声。
苏璃也不恼。
老巴克骂归骂，但那是真教东西。从怎么辨认铁矿石的成色，到怎么掌握火候，再到怎么发力才能不伤着腰，这老头虽然嘴臭，但手把手教得十分细致。
苏璃虽然有着五十年的阅历，但这打铁还真是头一遭。
刚开始那几天，他感觉自己这两条胳膊都不是自己的了，每天晚上躺在马厩的干草堆上，连翻身都得咬着牙。
但他硬是一声没吭。
不仅没吭声，哪怕累得手都在抖，第二天一大早，还是雷打不动地爬起来，先把院子扫了，再把水缸挑满。
这让原本想看这小白脸笑话的老巴克，眼神也慢慢变了。
从一开始的嫌弃，变成了后来的默许，甚至偶尔还会把自己那壶宝贝朗姆酒递给苏璃喝两口。
时间就这么一天天过去。
春去夏来，瓦丁村的蝉叫得人心烦意乱。
一个月后。
那个曾经面色苍白、仿佛风一吹就倒的落魄少爷不见了。
取而代之的，是一个精壮的汉子。
虽然苏璃的身板看着还是比不上老巴克那种熊一样的体格，但那原本单薄的肩膀上，已经挂上了一层薄薄的肌肉。
那是真正的活肌肉，线条流畅，紧实有力，随着他的动作在皮肤下滚动。
原本白得像面粉一样的皮肤，也被炉火和太阳烤成了健康的小麦色。
但这并没有折损他的颜值。
反而因为这点粗糙感，让那张原本精致得有些过分的脸，多了一股子野性的味道。
content_en:
Lunch was brought by Sena.
Originally, Su Li had no hope for this kind of food in a remote area.
But when he looked at the soft stewed beans in the bowl, as well as the piece of meat from an unknown animal, and smelled the aroma of herbs and oil, he couldn't find anything wrong with it.
"Is this...did you do this?" Su Li took the wooden spoon and looked up at Sena, who was looking through the door frame.
Sena still had the same timid look on her face, and she rubbed her hands back and forth on her apron, as if trying to rub out sparks from the cloth.
"Yeah." Sena nodded, her voice as low as a mosquito's hum, "If...if it doesn't suit your taste, I'll get you some pickles."
Su Li said nothing, lowered her head and took a sip.
The beans melted in your mouth, and although the meat was a bit burnt, it was very tasty when stewed. The most important thing was that an unknown weed was added to the soup, which suppressed the beany smell and instead extracted a fresh and sweet taste.
This craftsmanship is amazing.
Who would have thought that such a girl with a pockmarked face and rough-looking hands and feet could be so meticulous in cooking.
Su Li shoveled the large bowl of bean stew into her stomach in a few seconds, even wiping the soup base clean with black bread.
"It's delicious." Su Li put down the bowl and burped with satisfaction, "It's delicious."
The girl's face suddenly brightened up, and she couldn't hold the corners of her mouth down no matter how hard she tried. She wanted to laugh but was too embarrassed to smile. In the end, she suppressed it until her face turned red, she grabbed the empty bowl and turned around to run away.
"That...there will be more tonight!"
Looking at the figure running faster than a rabbit, Su Li leaned on the pile of firewood, touched her belly, and narrowed her eyes in contentment.
This day doesn't seem to be that difficult.
You have food and drink, you don't have to use your brain, you don't have to worry about being plotted by others, you just need to sell a little labor force, and you can get this kind of stability that even gods wouldn't trade for.
If you can continue to live like this until you are eighty years old, this F-level evaluation can also be regarded as a C-level, right?
"Boy! Get up when you're full!"
Old Buck's loud voice exploded in the yard, frightening Su Li's laziness that had just emerged.
"It's coming, it's coming." Su Li patted the dust on her butt and stood up resignedly.
Blacksmithing may seem like a laborious job, but in fact it is also a technical job.
Especially when you have a menopausal and grumpy master standing next to you.
"Stand straight! Are you Xiami?"
"Use your wrists hard! Don't use brute force! That's skill! Do you think you are hoeing?"
"Turn up the bellows! Didn't you eat? You put out the fire!"
Throughout the afternoon, in addition to the clanking of iron, there was the roar of Old Buck in the blacksmith shop.
Su Li was not annoyed either.
Old Buck scolded him, but he was really teaching something. From how to identify the color of iron ore, to how to control the heat, to how to exert force without hurting the waist, although the old man had a bad mouth, he taught him step by step in detail.
Although Su Li has fifty years of experience, this is really his first time blacksmithing.
In the first few days, he felt that his arms were no longer his own. Every night he lay on the hay in the stable, gritting his teeth even when he turned over.
But he remained silent.
Not only did he not say anything, even though his hands were shaking from exhaustion, he still got up unshakably early the next morning, swept the yard first, and then filled the water tank.
This made Old Buck, who originally wanted to see this pretty boy's joke, slowly change his eyes.
From the initial dislike, it turned into acquiescence later, and he would even occasionally pass his precious bottle of rum to Su Li for a few sips.
Time passed like this day by day.
As spring passes and summer comes, the cicadas in Wading Village are disturbing.
One month later.
The down-and-out young man who once looked pale and seemed to collapse at the slightest wind is gone.
Instead, there was a strong man.
Although Su Li's body still didn't look as good as Old Buck's bear-like physique, a thin layer of muscles had been put on her originally thin shoulders.
They were real living muscles, smooth, tight and powerful, rolling under the skin as he moved.
The skin that was originally as white as flour has been baked into a healthy wheat color by the fire and sun.
But this did not diminish his appearance.
On the contrary, because of this roughness, the face that was originally too delicate took on a wild flavor.
